optimized.title: Saudi Arabia Just Bombed Iraq
optimized.fullVoiceover: Saudi just bombed Iraq. Nobody is talking about it. Saudi fighter jets struck Iran-backed militia positions inside Iraq in May. Kuwait fired rockets too. The Gulf is at war and the US isn't leading it. Riyadh moved without Washington's lead. MBS ordered it solo. Sunni Saudi and Shia Iran are now fighting through proxies on Iraqi soil. Oil at one-forty isn't the ceiling. India imports forty percent from both countries. Saudi bombed Iraq. India hedged. So what's Washington's next move?
